name: nastran-bdf
description: Edit MSC/NX Nastran input decks (.bdf/.dat/.aset): field-aware hovers, small/large/free-field conversion, INCLUDE navigation, card references, outline and diagnostics. Read .f06 output files: section outline and folding, FATAL/WARNING messages in the Problems panel.

commands.title: Re-align Card(s) in Their Current Format
Use Blue Hover Highlight for Current Theme
Remove Blue Hover Highlight for Current Theme

colors.description: Background of every other field of fixed-format Nastran cards (keep it translucent so selections stay visible).
Field shading on lines with the cursor or a selection. It sits on top of the line highlight, so it needs slightly more opacity than the normal shading to keep the same contrast.

enumDescriptions: Keep each card in the format it is written in; only re-align fields.
Convert every card to small field (8 character fields).
Convert every card to large field (16 character fields).
Convert every card to free field (comma separated).
nastran.format.defaultStyle.description: Format used by 'Format Document' / 'Format Selection' for bulk data cards.

enumDescriptions: Numbers right-justified, text (YES, THRU, K ...) left-justified, as FEMAP writes them.
Right-justify every value, as the NX I-deas translator and pyNastran write them.
nastran.format.alignment.description: Justification of values in fields 2-9 of fixed-format (small/large field) cards. Nastran accepts values anywhere in the field; the card name (field 1) is always left-justified.

nastran.format.continuationMarker.description: Marker for small-field continuations, written in field 1 of the continuation line and in field 10 of the line before it (FEMAP style), e.g. '+'. Empty gives blank continuations. Large-field continuations always use '*' in field 1.

nastran.format.uppercase.description: Upper-case card names and character fields when formatting.

nastran.fieldShading.enabled.description: Shade every other field of fixed-format bulk data cards so field boundaries are visible.

nastran.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report formatting and field-type problems (missing decimal points, overflowing fields, unknown cards, missing INCLUDE files ...).

nastran.diagnostics.unknownCards.description: Report bulk data cards that are not in the extension's card database (the database is not complete, so this is off by default).

nastran.diagnostics.duplicateIds.description: Warn about duplicate grid/element/property/material/coordinate system IDs within a file.

nastran.folding.cardGroups.description: Fold runs of consecutive bulk data cards by category (grids & coordinate systems, elements, properties, materials, constraints, loads, parameters ...) and by card type (CQUAD4, CTRIA3, CHEXA ...). A comment line directly above a run is used as the fold title.

nastran.f06.messages.markdownDescription: Solver messages of `.f06` output files that are listed in the Problems panel and the Outline view (FATAL as errors, WARNING as warnings, INFORMATION as information).

nastran.maxLinesForAnalysis.description: Files longer than this skip diagnostics and field shading to keep the editor responsive.

nastran.includePaths.description: Extra directories searched when resolving relative INCLUDE paths (after the including file's directory and the workspace folders).

nastran.index.searchWorkspace.description: When a referenced ID is not found in the current file or its INCLUDEs, also search Nastran files in the workspace.

enumDescriptions: Insert a free-field template with a tab stop for each field (GRID,ID,CP,...). Use 'Convert to Small Field' afterwards if you prefer fixed format.
Insert a '$' comment line with the field names aligned to the 8-character columns, followed by the card name. Use Tab (8 spaces) to move between fields.
nastran.completion.style.description: Template inserted when completing a bulk data card name.

nastran.definitionFiles.markdownDescription: Extra definition files or folders (JSON) with private or company-specific cards, PARAMs, case control commands, DMAP statements and INCLUDE notes. Files in `~/.nastran/definitions/` are always loaded. Supports `~`, `${userHome}` and `${workspaceFolder}`. These files are never part of the extension.

nastran.comments.autoWrap.description: While typing in a $ comment line, move the last word to a new comment line when the line gets longer than nastran.comments.wrapColumn.

nastran.comments.wrapColumn.description: Maximum length of comment lines for automatic wrapping and "Nastran: Wrap Long Comment Lines" (Nastran reads 80 columns).

nastran.format.wrapComments.markdownDescription: Format Document / Format Selection also wrap `$` comment lines that are longer than `#nastran.comments.wrapColumn#`.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/parser.test.js out/test/definitions.test.js out/test/comments.test.js out/test/f06.test.js
